name: USD/JPY Rate Differential Model Horse-Race: 10Y vs 2Y
description: Research study comparing the US-Japan 10Y vs 2Y interest rate differential as drivers of USD/JPY. Computes changes-based rolling correlations (daily/weekly/monthly horizons at 60d and 252d windows) and OLS fair-value models via Engle-Granger for each tenor. Output includes rate differential time series, scatter-style fair value fits, deviation and z-score charts, rolling correlation comparisons, and a comprehensive summary table. Japan 2Y proxy uses INTGSTJPM193N (Japan Treasury Bill rate).
source:
# ============================================================================
# USD/JPY Rate Differential Model Horse-Race: 10Y vs 2Y
# Compare which tenor of the US-Japan rate differential better explains USD/JPY
# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

# USD/JPY FX
src_fx = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src_fx.c

# Time index for chart x-axes
ts = index().value

# US 10Y yield (daily, ffilled)
us_10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10', use_alfred=False)()
yield_us_10y = ffill(us_10y_raw.result)

# US 2Y yield (daily, ffilled)
us_2y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS2', use_alfred=False)()
yield_us_2y = ffill(us_2y_raw.result)

# Japan 10Y yield (monthly, ffilled)
jp_10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01JPM156N', use_alfred=False)()
yield_jp_10y = ffill(jp_10y_raw.result)

# Japan 2Y proxy: Treasury Bill rate (monthly, ffilled)
jp_2y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='INTGSTJPM193N', use_alfred=False)()
yield_jp_2y = ffill(jp_2y_raw.result)

# ============================================================================
# RATE DIFFERENTIALS
# ============================================================================

diff_10y = yield_us_10y - yield_jp_10y
diff_2y = yield_us_2y - yield_jp_2y

# ============================================================================
# CHANGES-BASED ROLLING CORRELATIONS
# ============================================================================

# Daily changes: 1-day diff in rate differential vs 1-day log return in FX
chg_diff_10y_1d = diff_10y - (diff_10y >> 1)
chg_diff_2y_1d = diff_2y - (diff_2y >> 1)
log_ret_fx_1d = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(close_fx)

# Weekly changes: 5-day diff vs 5-day log return
chg_diff_10y_5d = diff_10y - (diff_10y >> 5)
chg_diff_2y_5d = diff_2y - (diff_2y >> 5)
log_ret_fx_5d = returns(period=5, type=ReturnsType.log)(close_fx)

# Monthly changes: 21-day diff vs 21-day log return
chg_diff_10y_21d = diff_10y - (diff_10y >> 21)
chg_diff_2y_21d = diff_2y - (diff_2y >> 21)
log_ret_fx_21d = returns(period=21, type=ReturnsType.log)(close_fx)

# Rolling 60d correlations — daily changes
corr_daily_60d_10y = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=chg_diff_10y_1d, y=log_ret_fx_1d)
corr_daily_60d_2y = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=chg_diff_2y_1d, y=log_ret_fx_1d)

# Rolling 252d correlations — weekly changes
corr_weekly_252d_10y = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=chg_diff_10y_5d, y=log_ret_fx_5d)
corr_weekly_252d_2y = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=chg_diff_2y_5d, y=log_ret_fx_5d)

# Rolling 60d correlations — weekly changes (for summary table)
corr_weekly_60d_10y = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=chg_diff_10y_5d, y=log_ret_fx_5d)
corr_weekly_60d_2y = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=chg_diff_2y_5d, y=log_ret_fx_5d)

# ============================================================================
# OLS FAIR VALUE MODELS (via Engle-Granger, expanding window=2520)
# ============================================================================

# 10Y model: USD/JPY = intercept + slope * diff_10y
eg_10y = engle_granger(window=2520)(y=close_fx, x=diff_10y)
fair_value_10y = eg_10y.intercept + eg_10y.hedge_ratio * diff_10y
deviation_10y = close_fx - fair_value_10y
zscore_10y = zscore(window=252)(deviation_10y)

# 2Y model: USD/JPY = intercept + slope * diff_2y
eg_2y = engle_granger(window=2520)(y=close_fx, x=diff_2y)
fair_value_2y = eg_2y.intercept + eg_2y.hedge_ratio * diff_2y
deviation_2y = close_fx - fair_value_2y
zscore_2y = zscore(window=252)(deviation_2y)

# R-squared proxy: expanding correlation squared
corr_expanding_10y = rolling_corr(window=500, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=diff_10y, y=close_fx)
rsq_10y = corr_expanding_10y * corr_expanding_10y

corr_expanding_2y = rolling_corr(window=500, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=diff_2y, y=close_fx)
rsq_2y = corr_expanding_2y * corr_expanding_2y

# ============================================================================
# CHART 1: Rate Differential Over Time
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='10Y vs 2Y Rate Differential Over Time',
    category='1. Rate Differentials',
    y_axis_label='Yield Differential (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='10Y Differential', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2Y Differential', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(diff_10y, diff_2y))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 2: Actual USD/JPY vs Fair Value — 10Y Model (scatter-style)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Actual USD/JPY vs Fair Value: 10Y Model',
    category='2. Fair Value Models',
    x_axis_label='10Y Rate Differential (%)',
    y_axis_label='USD/JPY',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Actual USD/JPY', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='10Y Fair Value', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=diff_10y, y_values=(close_fx, fair_value_10y))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 3: Actual USD/JPY vs Fair Value — 2Y Model (scatter-style)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Actual USD/JPY vs Fair Value: 2Y Model',
    category='2. Fair Value Models',
    x_axis_label='2Y Rate Differential (%)',
    y_axis_label='USD/JPY',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Actual USD/JPY', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2Y Fair Value', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=diff_2y, y_values=(close_fx, fair_value_2y))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 4: Fair Value Deviation Over Time
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Fair Value Deviation: 10Y vs 2Y Models',
    category='3. Model Deviations',
    y_axis_label='Deviation (Yen)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='10Y Deviation', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2Y Deviation', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=4
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(deviation_10y, deviation_2y))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 5: Deviation Z-Score Over Time
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Deviation Z-Score: 10Y vs 2Y Models',
    category='3. Model Deviations',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='10Y Z-Score', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2Y Z-Score', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.5, title='+1.5 Std', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.5, title='-1.5 Std', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=5
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zscore_10y, zscore_2y))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 6: Rolling 252d Correlation (Weekly Changes)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 252d Correlation (Weekly Changes): 10Y vs 2Y',
    category='4. Rolling Correlations',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='10Y Weekly Corr 252d', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2Y Weekly Corr 252d', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.3, title='0.3', color=Color.Teal, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=6
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(corr_weekly_252d_10y, corr_weekly_252d_2y))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 7: Rolling 60d Correlation (Daily Changes)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60d Correlation (Daily Changes): 10Y vs 2Y',
    category='4. Rolling Correlations',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='10Y Daily Corr 60d', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2Y Daily Corr 60d', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.3, title='0.3', color=Color.Teal, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=7
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(corr_daily_60d_10y, corr_daily_60d_2y))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 8: Summary Table — 10Y vs 2Y Model Comparison
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='10Y vs 2Y Model Comparison',
        row_size=13,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=[
            'Current Diff 10Y (%)',
            'Current Diff 2Y (%)',
            'OLS Fair Value 10Y',
            'OLS Fair Value 2Y',
            'Current USD/JPY',
            'Deviation 10Y (yen)',
            'Deviation 2Y (yen)',
            'Z-Score 10Y',
            'Z-Score 2Y',
            'R-Squared 10Y',
            'R-Squared 2Y',
            'Weekly Corr 60d 10Y',
            'Weekly Corr 60d 2Y'
        ],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=7, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=8, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=9, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=10, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=11, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=12, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='5. Summary',
    order=8
)(diff_10y, diff_2y, fair_value_10y, fair_value_2y, close_fx, deviation_10y, deviation_2y, zscore_10y, zscore_2y, rsq_10y, rsq_2y, corr_weekly_60d_10y, corr_weekly_60d_2y)
